findings.what:
https://www.kaggle.com/code/amanatar/optimized-biohub-max-score now shows 'Version 6 of 6', 16m 41s on GPU T4 x2, '1001.0 second run - successful'. Its inputs are now x138's four datasets (DeepCenter prior, TemporalUNet3D seed314159, Tracking Support Pack, anvithpothula/biohub-v1284-head-s075). Best Score is '0.953 V4'. No V6 public score is visible, so we cannot tell whether V6 was submitted. The code is an x138 fork with the preset 'grandmaster_v4_iterative_flow' and the label '0.965+ grandmaster multi-horizon flow + quantile-consensus ensembling'; the 0.965+ is an author label with no evidence.
Knob changes vs x138:
- DET_THRESHOLD 0.965->0.960
- GAP_CLOSE_UM 5.0->5.8
- SAFE_DIV_MAX 9->10.5, SISTER_MAX 14->15, DIVERGE 2.25->1.50
- FRAME/GLOBAL caps 0.0076/0.00375 -> 0.012/0.006
- short-track rescue len 4->3 and prob 0.88->0.85
- dual-seed retention 0.90->0.75
New code:
- The secondary detection logits are z-score calibrated to the primary, then blended_det = max(primary, linear blend).
- The safe-division divergence gate is replaced by a 3-frame lookahead. It accepts if sister_dist >= 4.0 um or any step_dist >= 2.80 um, which makes the gate nearly off, so there are many more safe divisions.
The validator and PP-sweep cells are unchanged from x138.
